title: Mini Challenge — Load and Describe a Dataset

phase1.code:
# Mini Challenge: Load and Describe a Dataset

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=== Mini Challenge: Load and Describe ===\n")

# Create a sample dataset (simulating loading from a file)
print("Creating sample dataset...")

np.random.seed(42)
n = 200

data = {
    'Player_ID': [f'P{i:04d}' for i in range(n)],
    'Level': np.random.randint(1, 101, n),
    'Experience': np.random.randint(0, 10000, n),
    'Health': np.random.randint(50, 201, n),
    'Mana': np.random.randint(0, 101, n),
    'Gold': np.random.randint(0, 2000, n),
    'Attack': np.random.randint(5, 51, n),
    'Defense': np.random.randint(1, 31, n),
    'Speed': np.random.randint(1, 21, n),
    'Class': np.random.choice(['Warrior', 'Mage', 'Rogue', 'Archer', 'Paladin'], n),
    'Is_Active': np.random.choice([True, False], n, p=[0.75, 0.25])
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Introduce some missing values
for col in ['Level', 'Experience', 'Health', 'Mana', 'Gold']:
    mask = np.random.random(n) < 0.05
    df.loc[mask, col] = np.nan

print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {df.columns.tolist()}")

print("\n=== Task 1: Basic Information ===\n")

print(f"First 5 rows:\n{df.head()}")
print(f"\nData types:\n{df.dtypes}")
print(f"\nInfo:")
print(df.info())

print("\n=== Task 2: Missing Values ===\n")

print(f"Missing values:\n{df.isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Total missing: {df.isnull().sum().sum()}")
print(f"Missing percentage:\n{(df.isnull().sum() / len(df) * 100).round(2)}%")

print("\n=== Task 3: Summary Statistics ===\n")

print(f"Numeric summary:\n{df.describe()}")
print(f"\nCategorical summary:\n{df['Class'].value_counts()}")
print(f"\nActive players:\n{df['Is_Active'].value_counts()}")

print("\n=== Task 4: Data Cleaning ===\n")

# Fill missing values
print("Filling missing values...")
for col in ['Level', 'Experience', 'Health', 'Mana', 'Gold']:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna(df[col].median())

print(f"Missing after fill: {df.isnull().sum().sum()}")

print("\n=== Task 5: Additional Insights ===\n")

# Find top 5 players by Level
top_players = df.nlargest(5, 'Level')[['Player_ID', 'Level', 'Experience', 'Health']]
print(f"Top 5 players by Level:\n{top_players}")

# Average stats by class
print(f"\nAverage stats by class:\n{df.groupby('Class')[['Level', 'Health', 'Attack', 'Defense']].mean().round(2)}")

# Correlation
print(f"\nCorrelation between stats:\n{df[['Level', 'Experience', 'Health', 'Attack', 'Defense']].corr().round(3)}")

print("\n=== Task 6: Summary Report ===\n")

print("Summary Report:")
print(f"- Total players: {len(df)}")
print(f"- Active players: {df['Is_Active'].sum()}")
print(f"- Inactive players: {len(df) - df['Is_Active'].sum()}")
print(f"- Average level: {df['Level'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"- Average health: {df['Health'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"- Most common class: {df['Class'].mode().iloc[0]}")
print(f"- Highest level: {df['Level'].max()}")

print("\n=== Challenge Complete! ===\n")
